description: Transaction policy engine that evaluates every payment against configurable rules before signing. Three outcomes: auto-execute, pause-for-approval, reject.

evaluation_flow: 4. Allowlist check: recipient in approved addresses?

outcomes.auto_execute: All checks pass, amount under threshold → sign and broadcast immediately
outcomes.pause_for_approval: Amount exceeds threshold → generate approval-request UUID, notify operator, wait
outcomes.reject: Policy violation (blocked recipient, budget exceeded) → reject with reason

approval_mechanism.trigger: Transaction exceeds per-tx or daily threshold
approval_mechanism.notification: Operator notified via configured channel (Telegram for Kognai)
approval_mechanism.timeout: Configurable — auto-reject after N minutes if no response
approval_mechanism.audit: All approvals/rejections logged with operator ID + timestamp

kognai_extensions_beyond_agentpay: ACP-based dynamic thresholds (agents earn higher limits via performance)
Telegram approval flow (not CLI-only like AgentPay)
Constitutional compliance check (Five Principles audit before high-value tx)
CEO Wallet integration (x402 budget tracking per AMD-01)
